plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for NSCRTV HFC optical amplifiers such as Glassway EDFA / EYDFA (enterprise PEN 17409). It reports uptime, NE and slot internal temperatures, pump laser temperature, DC power supply voltage, and interface traffic.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Internal temperature of the NSCRTV / Glassway EDFA network element in degrees Celsius, from commonInternalTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.17409.1.3.1.13.0, -128 to 127). Values outside the range are dropped.

metrics.name: device_slot_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Internal temperature of each managed device slot in degrees Celsius, from commonDeviceInternalTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.17409.1.3.3.2.2.1.12, INDEX commonDeviceSlot). Values outside -128 to 127 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_pump_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature of each pump laser of the optical amplifier in degrees Celsius, from oaPumpTemp (1.3.6.1.4.1.17409.1.11.4.1.4, 0.1 degree units, divided by 10).

metrics.name: device_dc_power_voltage
metrics.description: Output voltage of each internal DC power supply of the optical amplifier in volts, from oaDCPowerVoltage (1.3.6.1.4.1.17409.1.11.7.1.2, 0.1 V units, divided by 10). The power_name tag carries oaDCPowerName.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
